title: Through which CLI command or CLI query does the command line reach the 19 commands and queries it does not reach now?
description: After the CLI split (D2), lathe check warns step-unreached for 88 flow steps: they invoke one of 19 commands or queries that no CLI command or CLI query sits under, and ST-IF01 (Command line) offers their use cases. The old cli_command records had no record for them, so this is a design gap, not a lost record. For each, the options are: add a CLI command or CLI query under it with its usage (and a CLI handler for its file); make the steps variants of another interface; or stop offering the use case through ST-IF01. The commands and queries: ST-DIS-CMD08, ST-DIS-QRY03, ST-DLV-CMD01, ST-DLV-CMD02, ST-DLV-CMD03, ST-DLV-CMD04, ST-GEN-CMD05, ST-SUP-CMD01, ST-SUP-CMD02, ST-SUP-CMD03, ST-SUP-CMD04, ST-SUP-CMD05, ST-SUP-CMD06, ST-SUP-CMD07, ST-SUP-CMD08, ST-SUP-CMD09, ST-SUP-CMD10, ST-SUP-CMD11, ST-SUP-QRY03.

title: May the notes of the business outcomes name the new CLI records?
description: The notes of ST-BO01, ST-BO03, ST-BO04, ST-BO06, ST-BO07 and ST-BO08 name the removed records ST-DIS-CLI11, ST-SUP-CLI04, ST-ASR-CLI03 and ST-SUP-CLI05. Their measured_by links now point at ST-DIS-QRY05-CLI, ST-SUP-QRY04-CLI, ST-ASR-CMD03-CLI and ST-SUP-QRY05-CLI. The notes are design text, so the CLI split did not change them. I propose to replace each old ID in the notes with its new ID, and change nothing else.

title: Should ST-STD-CODE-R01, ST-STD-CODE-R02 and ST-ASR-SP06 name the CLI handler?
description: ST-STD-CODE-R01 says a cmd package is named by the CLI command records of several domains; after the split, CLI handler records name it, and CLI commands name no file. ST-STD-CODE-R02 lists the kinds whose title is the name in code (a handler, predicate, ...); assure now holds the CLI handler to it, as a handler titled by the identifier its file declares, such as main.gate. ST-ASR-SP06 says a CLI command never satisfies it, which stays true. I propose: in R01, CLI handler records in place of CLI command records; in R02, add CLI handler to the list; and in ST-ASR-SP06, add that a CLI handler is read as a handler. The code and the tests follow this already.

title: How may an essential CLI record name the program it runs and what it reads?
description: A CLI command or CLI query is now essential, and its title is the invocation a person types, such as assure gate change. PR 44 made assure, git and Cosign technology words, so lathe check warns accidental-in-essential for ST-ASR-CMD01-CLI, ST-ASR-CMD02-CLI, ST-ASR-CMD03-CLI and ST-ASR-QRY01-CLI (title assure, description git) and ST-BLD-CMD05-CLI (description cosign). Lathe also refuses a write of an essential record whose description names a word such as repository, json, table or command line, so the split reworded nine descriptions (ST-ASR-CMD01-CLI, ST-ASR-CMD02-CLI, ST-ASR-CMD03-CLI, ST-ASR-QRY01-CLI: repository to checkout; ST-BLD-CMD03-CLI: on the command line to as a flag; ST-DIS-CMD05-CLI: qualification.json to its qualification record; ST-DIS-QRY04-CLI and ST-DIS-QRY05-CLI: --json moved into the usage; ST-SUP-QRY02-CLI: as a table to one to a line). Options: accept the five warnings, as the invocation is what a person types; drop assure from the technology words; or move the mechanism (go run, git objects, the step summary, cosign) from the descriptions into the CLI handlers' descriptions, so the essential description says only the flags and the output. Please also confirm the nine rewordings.
